screened.matching_method: Official semicolon surname/givens reordered into natural order; lifespan and trailing titles/descriptions excluded; accents, punctuation and honorifics normalized. Directory comma surname/givens reordered identically; optional observed parenthetical given-name variants also screened. Baseline display name is not used for past-fellow full-name matching. Existing QID labels/aliases are not used.

negative_evidence_limit: No canonical or observed-parenthetical-variant full-name match in this small returned directory slice; this does not establish absence from DIB.
offline_QA_correction: Earlier screen used baseline name, which omits surnames for many past fellows; superseded by this canonical full-name screen without new network requests.
